profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full-stack
profile.summary:
I am an experienced full stack developer with expertise in: Java, JavaScript, Angular, and Test automation. With a strong foundation in software engineering and a focus on delivering high-quality applications, I bring a versatile skill set to the table. From designing and developing robust back-end systems using Java to creating dynamic front-end interfaces with JavaScript and Angular, I have a comprehensive understanding of the full stack development process.
 
With a dedication to continuous learning and a collaborative mindset, I am ready to contribute my skills and experience to drive the success of your projects.

Let's connect and discuss how I can add value to your team.

Tech stack: Java, Spring, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular, Cucumber, Gherkin, BDD, Agile

positions.description: Building the next generation of EMR scheduling and practice management software, developing high-performance, scalable APIs that support millions of patient interactions.
